narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -11.84 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.1697-0.1711 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.1792; the first objective pays 1.28R at 0.1674.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.1792 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.28 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

basis.coinbaseReason: Coinbase premium tracked for BTC/ETH/SOL only

notes: taker buyVolUsd/sellVolUsd = Binance base-asset taker volume converted at the perp last price
funding: venues missing from the OI chart were weighted at the mean OI of matched venues
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
